meaning_en: a person or thing that saves you from a bad situation
quote: You are a life saver.
quote_cn: 你真是救了我一命。
example: The spare tyre was a real life saver.
example_cn: 那个备胎真是救了命。
note: 口语。life-saver 也指救生圈，字面双关。

meaning_en: respect and admiration
quote: Hey, mad props.
quote_cn: 嘿，真服了你。
example: Mad props to you for covering for me.
example_cn: 替我圆场这份情我记下了。
note: 1990年代黑人俚语，props 是 proper 的变音；年轻人多用 shout-out。

meaning_en: a stupid, clumsy move
quote: which is a bonehead maneuver
quote_cn: 那是个蠢到家了的操作。
example: Reading the map while driving is a bonehead maneuver.
example_cn: 开车时看地图是很蠢的行为。
note: bonehead=笨蛋，美式口语；英式更常说 daft。

meaning_en: remain optimistic and not dwell on problems
quote: We're just gonna stay positive, right?
quote_cn: 我们就往好处想，对吧？
example: Stay positive; the interview went better than you think.
example_cn: 往好处想，那次面试比你以为的好。
note: 此处是心理安慰，不是数学上的「保持为正」。

meaning_en: to stop being connected and go on alone
quote: we will go our separate ways
quote_cn: 我们就此分道扬镳。
example: The two brothers went their separate ways after the lawsuit.
example_cn: 打完官司后兄弟俩就分道扬镳了。
note: 也作 go your separate ways。强调彻底切断关系。

meaning_en: to feel or show the same way about something, more strongly
quote: That goes double for me.
quote_cn: 我也正想说这个。
example: If you hate that film, it goes double for me.
example_cn: 你要是讨厌那部电影，我更讨厌。
note: 口语，指感受完全一致；常用 It goes double for me 表示强烈赞同或反感。

meaning_en: unfinished matters needing attention
quote: We got loose ends here!
quote_cn: 我们这边还有尾巴没处理！
example: A few loose ends before we sign off.
example_cn: 签字之前还有几件收尾的事。
note: 固定用复数。tie up loose ends=收尾；at loose ends=茫然无措。

meaning_en: to say you are ill and will not come to work or school
quote: Ditch it, man, call in sick.
quote_cn: 别去了，请个病假。
example: He called in sick and went to the beach instead.
example_cn: 他请了病假，结果去了海滩。
note: 搭配 call in sick / call in sick leave。名词 sick leave=病假。

meaning_en: to refuse or reject something
quote: has to go through all these photos and turn them down
quote_cn: 得把这些照片全过一遍并退回去。
example: The committee turned down our proposal again.
example_cn: 委员会又一次否决了我们的提案。
note: 也指调低音量 turn it down；此处是被拒绝。

meaning_en: a bra
quote: some new type of brassiere, or something
quote_cn: 说是出了种新型胸罩什么的。
example: Brassiere sizing changed for the first time in decades.
example_cn: 胸罩尺码几十年来第一次改变。
note: 美式拼 brassiere(不重音 re)，英式 bra 更常用；是 school health 教材里的正式词。

meaning_en: to listen closely to something
quote: I went and put my ear to the RV
quote_cn: 我凑到房车那儿听了听。
example: She put her ear to the door and listened.
example_cn: 她把耳朵贴到门上听着。
note: put your ear to something＝凑近听；ear to the ground＝倾听消息。

meaning_en: to escape from confinement
quote: I think he's trying to get loose.
quote_cn: 我觉得他在试图挣脱。
example: The horse got loose and bolted.
example_cn: 马挣脱了缰绳跑了。
note: 此义指挣脱束缚；lose/loose 一字之差。

meaning_en: to panic or become very agitated
quote: I'm freaking out over here!
quote_cn: 我这边快急疯了！
example: Don't freak out, it's only a scratch.
example_cn: 别慌，只是一道划痕。
note: 比 panic 程度低；freak someone out=吓到某人。

meaning_en: to spring suddenly on a target
quote: waiting to pounce!
quote_cn: 等着猛扑过来！
example: The cat pounced on the mouse.
example_cn: 猫猛地扑向老鼠。
note: 字面猫扑 prey；引申为抓住时机突袭。

meaning_en: to wait patiently for the right moment
quote: I would just lie back down, and bide my time.
quote_cn: 我就重新躺下，耐心等时机。
example: He bided his time until the right moment.
example_cn: 他耐心等待合适的时机。
note: 正式/书面；bide one's time 与 wait one's turn 不同，指等待良机。

meaning_en: completely unconscious
quote: Because he was out cold.
quote_cn: 因为他当时昏死过去了。
example: The boxer left his opponent out cold.
example_cn: 拳击手把对手打得昏了过去。
note: 只用于失去意识，不能用于睡着（asleep）。knock out cold 更强。

meaning_en: requires action now
quote: This isn't even the issue that demands immediate attention
quote_cn: 这甚至都不是那个需要马上处理的问题。
example: The leak demands immediate attention.
example_cn: 泄漏问题必须立刻处理。
note: 书面语；demand 作动词时「要求」用复数 demands 表示单数主语。

meaning_en: behaviour considered impolite or wrong
quote: I don't suppose it is bad form to just flip a coin
quote_cn: 抛硬币决定大概不算失礼吧。
example: It was bad form to leave without saying goodbye.
example_cn: 不告而别很失礼。
note: 英式较常见；it is bad form to do sth＝做某事有失体面。

meaning_en: weak and easily broken; unconvincing
meaning_cn: 薄而不结实的；站不住脚的
quote: this feels kind of flimsy
quote_cn: 这塑料摸起来挺不结实。
example: That's a flimsy excuse and we both know it.
example_cn: 那个借口很站不住脚，我们俩都清楚。
note: 既形容物理脆弱，也形容论点/借口无力。 flimsy alibi=站不住脚的不在场证明。

meaning_en: to eat away at something until it is destroyed
quote: Any decent acid's gonna eat right through this.
quote_cn: 随便什么像样的酸都能把这腐蚀穿。
example: Rust ate through the pipe in a year.
example_cn: 锈一年内就把管子蛀穿了。
note: 此处是被强酸穿透；eat into＝逐渐侵蚀。

meaning_en: to be needlessly unpleasant about a refusal
meaning_cn: 因为被拒绝就摆臭脸；小气
quote: Be a dick about it.
quote_cn: 那你就小气去吧。
example: Don't be a dick about it, it was a mistake.
example_cn: 别为这点事摆脸色，那是失误。
note: 粗俗但常用；dick=混蛋，与生理义无关。名词 a dick=讨厌的人。

meaning_en: to gradually bring yourself to do something unpleasant
meaning_cn: 鼓起勇气去做（不想做的事）
quote: I'm working up to it.
quote_cn: 我正在鼓起勇气去做。
example: He worked up to asking for a raise.
example_cn: 他鼓起勇气去要求加薪。
note: 强调心理上的逐步准备；work up the courage to do sth 同义。

meaning_en: someone exhausted and disengaged from their usual life
quote: this big secret you seem to be discussing with some druggie burn-out
quote_cn: 你在跟一个嗑药的废物讨论什么大秘密。
example: The company is full of quiet burn-outs.
example_cn: 公司里到处都是 quietly 倦怠的人。
note: burnout=职业倦怠(不可数)；a burn-out 指人(可数)。
